pages.name: features
pages.title: Freed features: notes, coding, letters, and EHR push

headings.text: A smarter scribe for the whole visit
Freed listens once, then writes the note in your format, answers your clinical questions, suggests the codes, drafts the letters, and pushes it all to your EHR.
Walk in already prepared, then record the conversation or dictate parts yourself. Either way, you type less and save mental space for the next patient.
Record a Spanish-language visit and get notes in English. Or send instructions in the language your patient reads at home.
Freed starts from a template built by practicing clinicians, learns how you actually write, and lets you reshape any note by asking.
Instructions, letters, codes, and the chart entry — all done before your next appointment.
Using something else? Most browser-based EHRs work with Freed’s Chrome extension. Or you can simply copy & paste your note — still faster than writing it from scratch.
The same scribe, coordinated across everyone who touches patient care.
